chunks: From him, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Mudrik ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Islam is bare, so clothe it with bashfulness (hayā'), and adorn it with dignity (waqār), and its manliness is righteous deed (al-'amal al-ṣāliḥ), and its pillar is piety (al-wara'), and for every thing is a foundation, and the foundation of Islam is our love, the People of the Household.'
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Mudrik ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) – similar to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the foundation of Islam according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi employs a metaphorical structure to define Islam’s spiritual architecture, where bashfulness (hayā’) and dignity (waqār) serve as its external manifestations, while righteous action and piety constitute its internal substance. The narration culminates in the Shi‘a theological principle that love for the Ahl al-Bayt is the 'foundation' (asās) of the faith, linking doctrinal allegiance directly to the validity of Islamic practice. This establishes a hierarchical relationship where metaphysical love underpins the ethical and ritual dimensions of the religion.

en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Mudrik Bin Abdul Rahman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Al-Islām is bare, so clothe it with the bashfulness, and adorn it with the dignity, and its personality is the righteous deed, and its pillar is the piety, and for every thing is a foundation, and the foundation of Al-Islām is love for usasws the Peopleasws of the Household’.

Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Ma’bad, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Mudrik Bin Abdul Rahman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from Mudrik ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Islam is bare. Its dress is bashfulness, dignity is its ornament, virtuous deeds are its kindness and strict following of law is its support. Everything has a foundation. The foundation of Islam is loving us, Ahl al- Bayt .’”

Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ali ibn Ma’bad from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from Murik ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from abu ‘Abd Allah, recipient of divine supreme covenant: a similar Hadith.
